title.zh: 反事实物理视频：两条只差一条规律的短片
title.en: Counterfactual physics video: two clips that differ by one law

summary.zh: 同一个场景渲两遍，一遍物理正确，一遍只改一条规律：掩膜精确到像素，六道硬门全部自动判定。附三十二个生成器各一条真实样本。
summary.en: The same scene rendered twice, once with correct physics and once with a single law broken: pixel-exact masks, six gates decided by machine, and one real sample from each of thirty-two generators.
